# Rehab.com

> A comprehensive directory of 20,000+ drug and alcohol rehab centers across the U.S. with facility ratings, insurance verification, and treatment program comparisons.

Rehab.com serves as a centralized resource for finding and comparing addiction treatment facilities nationwide. The platform features interactive tools for facility discovery, state-specific directories, and detailed information about inpatient and outpatient treatment options to help individuals find appropriate recovery resources.

## Key Topics

- Drug and alcohol rehab centers
- Addiction recovery
- Detox centers
- Inpatient treatment
- Outpatient programs
- Insurance accepted
- Treatment facility ratings
- State-by-state search
- Facility finder
- Recovery resources
- Soberman's Estate
- Rise in Malibu
- Boca Recovery Center
- Treatment program comparison
- Addiction treatment finder

## Core Directory & Search

- [Find the Best Drug & Alcohol Rehabs in the U.S.](https://www.rehab.com): Homepage: Directory of 20,000+ analyzed drug & alcohol rehab centers with insurance verification
- [Find and Compare the Best Rehab Centers Near You](https://www.rehab.com/centers): Interactive map tool to find and compare rehab centers by location with ratings and reviews

## State-Specific Directories

- [Highest Reviewed Drug Rehab Centers In California](https://www.rehab.com/california): State-specific directory of top-rated California drug rehab and detox centers
